World model (revised):
- K4 now matches P8 after one UP, but level not complete → goal is not merely "any palette match"; likely each slot has a fixed target glyph (initial 9 were already correct; K4's target is one of unused {P4, P11}, or P8 in a specific orientation).

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def win(L,r0,r1,c0,c1):
    return tuple(tuple(1 if L[r][c]=='B' else 0 for c in range(c0,c1)) for r in range(r0,r1))
def trim(g):
    rs=[r for r in range(len(g)) if any(g[r])]; cs=[c for c in range(len(g[0])) if any(g[r][c] for r in range(len(g)))]
    return tuple(tuple(g[r][c] for c in range(cs[0],cs[-1]+1)) for r in range(rs[0],rs[-1]+1))
def trs(g):
    n=len(g); m=len(g[0]); out=[]
    g0=g
    for k in range(4):
        out.append(g0); out.append(tuple(tuple(row[::-1] for row in g0)))
        g0=tuple(tuple(g0[n-1-c][r] for c in range(n)) for r in range(m))
    return out
cur = current_frame.ascii.splitlines()
init = history[0].frame.ascii.splitlines()
pal={}
pwins=[(5,10,13,21),(5,10,22,30),(5,10,35,43),(5,10,45,53),
       (14,19,13,21),(14,19,22,30),(14,19,35,43),(14,19,45,53),
       (23,28,13,21),(23,28,22,30),(23,28,35,43),(23,28,45,53)]
for i,(r0,r1,c0,c1) in enumerate(pwins):
    pal[i+1]=trim(win(cur,r0,r1,c0,c1))
# top grid static?
diff=sum(1 for i,(r0,r1,c0,c1) in enumerate(pwins) if trim(win(init,r0,r1,c0,c1))!=pal[i+1])
print('top grid diffs vs initial:', diff)
K4W=(52,57,35,42)
def k4():
    return trim(win(current_frame.ascii.splitlines(),*K4W))
def info(g):
    m=[p for p,pg in pal.items() if g in trs(pg)]
    # which transform index
    tidx=[i for p,pg in pal.items() for i,t in enumerate(trs(pg)) if t==g]
    return m,tidx
g=k4()
print('state0', info(g))
for i in range(6):
    action(['UP'])
    g=k4()
    print('state%d'% (i+1), info(g))
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print('COMPLETED'); break

def win(L,r0,r1,c0,c1):
    return tuple(tuple(1 if L[r][c]=='B' else 0 for c in range(c0,c1)) for r in range(r0,r1))
def trim(g):
    rs=[r for r in range(len(g)) if any(g[r])]; cs=[c for c in range(len(g[0])) if any(g[r][c] for r in range(len(g)))]
    return tuple(tuple(g[r][c] for c in range(cs[0],cs[-1]+1)) for r in range(rs[0],rs[-1]+1))
def trs(g):
    n=len(g); m=len(g[0]); out=[]
    g0=g
    for k in range(4):
        out.append(g0); out.append(tuple(tuple(row[::-1] for row in g0)))
        g0=tuple(tuple(g0[n-1-c][r] for c in range(n)) for r in range(m))
    return out
cur = current_frame.ascii.splitlines()
init = history[0].frame.ascii.splitlines()
pal={}
pwins=[(5,10,13,21),(5,10,22,30),(5,10,35,43),(5,10,45,53),
       (14,19,13,21),(14,19,22,30),(14,19,35,43),(14,19,45,53),
       (23,28,13,21),(23,28,22,30),(23,28,35,43),(23,28,45,53)]
for i,(r0,r1,c0,c1) in enumerate(pwins):
    pal[i+1]=trim(win(cur,r0,r1,c0,c1))
# top grid static?
diff=sum(1 for i,(r0,r1,c0,c1) in enumerate(pwins) if trim(win(init,r0,r1,c0,c1))!=pal[i+1])
print('top grid diffs vs initial:', diff)
K4W=(52,57,35,42)
def k4():
    return trim(win(current_frame.ascii.splitlines(),*K4W))
def info(g):
    m=[p for p,pg in pal.items() if g in trs(pg)]
    # which transform index
    tidx=[i for p,pg in pal.items() for i,t in enumerate(trs(pg)) if t==g]
    return m,tidx
g=k4()
print('state0', info(g))
for i in range(6):
    action(['UP'])
    g=k4()
    print('state%d'% (i+1), info(g))
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print('COMPLETED'); break
